items.author: blueteamsec1
items.context: blueteamsec1: titular que vincula una falla de la hardware wallet Coldcard con un robo de Bitcoin de $70 millones «en 41 minutos» (enlace a nota). Otros posts del mismo debate hablan de una falla de entropía/RNG en el firmware que debilitó las semillas; las cifras varían según la fuente.
items.suggested_text: The uncomfortable lesson: the seed was only as random as firmware most users could never audit. Updating doesn't fix a seed that was born weak. Generating your own entropy and checking it on an offline device removes that dependency. I wrote a book on building that air-gapped $BTC setup yourself, free on Kindle until Wednesday: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: LarkDavis
items.context: Lark Davis: «Why is Bitcoin falling? 4 key reasons», entre ellas expectativas de alza de tasas de la Fed en diciembre (mayor costo de oportunidad frente a bonos) y la correlación con acciones tecnológicas/IA en debilidad.
items.suggested_text: Good list, but none of those reasons change what $BTC is, only who's willing to hold it through higher rates. For spot holders without leverage, macro drawdowns are mostly a test of time horizon, not of the thesis.

items.author: PhilakoneCrypto
items.context: Philakone: resumen diario. BTC cerró en $73.763; Supertrend diario bajista; precio bajo la SMA 50 y sobre la SMA 200; RSI 33,98. Soporte $73.669 / resistencia $81.188. Cerró sobre la SMA 200 tras perder el mínimo de septiembre.
items.suggested_text: Support at $73.7K with a close at $73.76K means $BTC is basically sitting on the line. Holding above the 200 SMA after losing September's low is the detail I'd watch: a daily close back under it would change the read more than any single wick.
